sources.title: Cash out speed options (Standard vs Instant)
sources.claim: Standard transfers free, 1-3 business days; Instant to linked debit card 0.5%-2.5% fee (min $0.25-$1, max $75), fee displayed before completion.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
Conflicts with S02 headline '0.5%-1.75%' instant fee.
sources.local_note: Standard free 1-3 business days; Instant 0.5%-2.5% (min $0.25-$1, max $75), fee shown before completing.

sources.title: Free ATM Withdrawals
sources.claim: Green status gives free in-network ATM withdrawals; $300+ monthly paycheck direct deposit triggers ATM fee reimbursement incl. operator fees, each qualifying deposit adds 31 days; Cash App charges $2.50 at any ATM otherwise.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
Differs from S03 wording (all in-network + one out-of-network reimbursed).
sources.local_note: Green: free in-network ATM. $300+ paycheck DD: reimburses ATM incl. operator fees, +31 days per deposit. Otherwise $2.50 Cash App fee.

sources.title: Paper Money Deposits
sources.claim: Verified customers only; $1 flat fee per deposit for all customers including Green; $5,000/rolling 7 days, $10,000/rolling 30 days; $5 min, $500 max per deposit; some retailers $20 min by card swipe; retailer limits/ID may apply.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
A search-result snippet from another Cash App page states paper deposits are free with $300 deposits/$500 spend; not confirmed on this page.
sources.local_note: Verified only; $1 fee for all incl. Green; $5k/7d, $10k/30d; $5-$500 per deposit; retailer limits and ID checks.

sources.title: Mobile Check Deposits
sources.claim: Eligible customers can deposit paychecks, personal, cashier's and government checks; free; 5 checks/30 days, $3,500/check, $7,500/30 days; funds generally up to 6 business days, up to 8 in limited cases; keep check 14 days; under 180 days old; endorse 'Cash App Deposit'.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
sources.local_note: Free; 5 checks/30d, $3,500/check, $7,500/30d; funding up to 6 (sometimes 8) business days; endorse 'Cash App Deposit'.

sources.title: I sent money to the wrong account
sources.claim: Cash App can't cancel or refund a completed payment; sender asks recipient for refund via Activity > Report an Issue, or via Request after 30 days; recipient may not respond and funds may be unrecoverable.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
sources.local_note: Cannot cancel/refund completed payment; Report an Issue asks recipient; after 30 days use Request; funds may be unrecoverable.

sources.title: Canceling a payment
sources.claim: Cash App-to-Cash App payments are instant and usually can't be canceled; check Activity for cancel option; recipient can Refund; sender can Request funds back.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
sources.local_note: Payments instant, usually not cancelable; recipient Refund action; Request button.

sources.title: Paycheck deposits and Cash App Green
sources.claim: Lists deposits counting toward Green (ACH direct deposit, OCT payouts, government benefits) and those that do not (tax refunds, insurance payouts, one-time ACH transfers); OCTs up to $10,000/day.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
sources.local_note: Green-qualifying deposits: ACH DD, OCTs, gov benefits; excluded: tax refunds, insurance, one-time ACH. OCT up to $10,000/day.

sources.title: Account Limits
sources.claim: Unverified and sponsored: send/receive up to $1,000 per rolling 30 days, total account limit $1,500; verified send up to $40,000 per rolling 30 days; verified receive limits account-specific in Limits tab; unverified balance limit $1,000.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
A search snippet cited '$250 per 7 days' for unverified sending; not on this page — treat as stale/unconfirmed.
sources.local_note: Unverified/sponsored $1,000/30d, $1,500 total; verified send $40,000/30d; receive limits per account; unverified balance cap $1,000.

sources.title: Why do I need to verify my identity
sources.claim: IDV required for >$1,000/30 days or >$1,500 total, ordering a card, buying bitcoin or stocks, sponsoring 13-17, connecting accounts; asks legal name, DOB, last 4 SSN/ITIN; may request full SSN, address, photo ID, income/source of funds.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
sources.local_note: IDV gates: >$1,000/30d, card order, bitcoin/stocks, sponsoring teens, connecting accounts. Name, DOB, SSN4; maybe ID/income.

sources.title: What is a $cashtag
sources.claim: $cashtag is a unique identifier with shareable URL cash.app/$cashtag; can only be changed twice; at least 1 letter, max 20 characters; blue badge marks verified public figures/brands.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
sources.local_note: Unique $cashtag + URL; change twice; >=1 letter, <=20 chars; blue badge = verified public figure/brand.

sources.title: Cash App Green
sources.claim: Green via $500 card/Cash App Pay spend or $300 qualifying paycheck deposits per month; benefits active through following month: higher Borrow limits, overdraft up to $200, highest savings rate, 5 custom offers weekly, free in-network ATM, priority phone support, waived FX on card-present; sponsored accounts not eligible for overdraft/Borrow; Borrow not in CO, IA, OR; Borrow issued by First Electronic Bank or Square Financial Services.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
Borrow issuer named as First Electronic Bank or SFS here vs SFS only on borrow help page.
sources.local_note: Green: $500 spend or $300 DD monthly; active through next month; overdraft $200, top APY, 5 offers, free in-network ATM, priority support, no card-present FX.

sources.title: Free Overdraft Coverage
sources.claim: Free overdraft coverage up to $200 after turning it on; card purchases beyond balance covered automatically; provided by Cash App, a Block brand.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
sources.local_note: Turn on overdraft; up to $200 covered automatically on card purchases; no fee.

sources.title: Cash App Savings
sources.claim: Savings is a separate balance without its own account number; up to five goals; transfer in from Cash balance, linked source, savings or another goal; transfer out only to Cash balance; Round Ups with activated card; Paychecks allocation to up to five goals.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
sources.local_note: Savings folder, no separate account number; 5 goals; Round Ups (card); paycheck % to savings; withdraw via Cash balance.

sources.title: Understanding Savings Interest
sources.claim: Interest passed through from FBO account at Wells Fargo; highest rate with $300 DD or $500 card/tag spend; accrues daily, compounds monthly; must have Cash App Card or sponsor accounts and be 18+; business accounts and backup-withholding customers ineligible; sponsored accounts with sponsor approval.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
Rates subject to change; example 3% APY is illustrative only.
sources.local_note: Pass-through interest via Wells Fargo FBO; daily accrual monthly compounding; needs card or sponsorship, 18+; business ineligible.

sources.title: No-Fee Savings with High Interest
sources.claim: Earn up to 3.5%; 1.5% after confirming tax info; 3.5% every month with Green; no fees or minimums; unlimited transfers between Cash balance and savings.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
Page step 1 says 1.5% after tax info, while FAQ says interest requires a Cash App Card and personal account.
sources.local_note: Up to 3.5%; 1.5% base after tax info; 3.5% with Green; no fees/minimums; unlimited transfers.

sources.title: Bitcoin Pricing / fees
sources.claim: Market buy/sell fees: $1-499 2.0%, $500-999 1.5%, $1000-1999 0.9%, $2000+ 0%; 0% via Auto Invest, Round Ups, Paid in Bitcoin; spread 0%-0.75%; Lightning from Cash balance 0.9%; on-chain withdrawal Standard free (min ₿100,000 sats), Rush/Priority pro-rata + up to $2/$3.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
Cross-exchange comparison table is Cash App's own marketing claim.
sources.local_note: Tiered bitcoin fees 2.0%/1.5%/0.9%/0%; spread 0-0.75%; Lightning 0.9%; withdrawal speeds Standard free, Rush, Priority.

sources.title: Investing Fees
sources.claim: No commission or minimum; regulatory TAF and SEC fees on sells passed through; TAF stated as $0.000000/share for Oct 1-Dec 31 2026; SEC $20.60 per $1M; outbound transfer fees per House Rules; fractional shares non-transferable.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
Search snippet quoted TAF $0.000195/share — differing period values; treat as live config.
sources.local_note: No commission; pass-through SEC/FINRA sell fees (TAF $0 Oct-Dec 2026; SEC $20.60/$1M); fractional non-transferable.

sources.title: Keep your money and account safe
sources.claim: One-time sign-in code each login; review/remove trusted devices; Security Lock requires passcode/Touch ID/Face ID per payment; text/email payment notifications; hide virtual card info; toggle Enable Card to disable card.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
sources.local_note: Sign-in OTP; device list; Security Lock per payment; payment notifications; disable card toggle.

sources.title: Why is my account locked
sources.claim: Cash App may temporarily lock accounts on unusual activity, typically 24-48 hours; cannot trade stocks during lock; notification on unlock.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
Page also says lock 'will not prevent you from sending future payments' — ambiguous vs during-lock behavior.
sources.local_note: Provider-initiated lock 24-48h on unusual activity; no stock trades during lock.

sources.title: Borrow fees
sources.claim: One-time flat fee based on loan amount shown before acceptance; $5 outstanding balance fee after 3+ days overdue; 1.25% non-compounding weekly interest after 7+ days overdue; no prepayment, skip (except final), credit-check or monthly fees; terms viewable in Activity.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
sources.local_note: Flat fee shown pre-accept; $5 after 3 days late; 1.25%/week simple after 7 days; no prepayment fee.

sources.title: About Borrow
sources.claim: Borrow $20 up to approved offer; flat fee; no credit score check; repay all at once, weekly, or as funds come in; funds added immediately; not in CO, IA, OR; issued and serviced by Square Financial Services.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
S04 states first-time limit up to $400, overall up to $500, average first limit $153.
sources.local_note: $20 to offer; no credit check; flexible repay; funds instant; not CO/IA/OR; SFS issuer.

sources.title: Learn more about Afterpay on Cash App Card
sources.claim: Eligible users order Afterpay-capable card; toggle Afterpay on before each purchase and accept terms (amount financed, payment frequency, finance charge); turns off after each purchase; no credit check, no credit bureau reporting.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
S02/card page say 'no hidden fees'/'no interest' while this page discloses a finance charge.
sources.local_note: Toggle Afterpay before purchase, accept terms each time incl. finance charge; auto-off after purchase; no credit check.

sources.title: Order Cash App Card
sources.claim: Free customizable Visa debit card tied to balance; 13+ with parental approval or 18+; arrives 7-10 business days; card details may be available before arrival for online use and Apple/Google Pay.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
/card page says within 10 business days; families page says managed kids 6-12 can get a card.
sources.local_note: Free Visa debit; 13+ w/ approval or 18+; 7-10 business days; early virtual details possible.

sources.title: Dispute a Cash App Card transaction
sources.claim: In-app Support > Cash App Card > Dispute a purchase or phone 1-800-969-1940 8AM-9:30PM EST; within 60 days of statement; update within 10 business days else provisional credit; up to 45 days; appeals within 60 days.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
Phone hours differ from P2P dispute page (9AM-7PM).
sources.local_note: Card disputes within 60 days; 10-business-day update or provisional credit; up to 45 days; appeal 60 days.

sources.title: Dispute a Peer-to-Peer Payment
sources.claim: Support > Payments > Report an Issue; phone 9AM-7PM EST; 60-day window; 10 business days/provisional credit/45 days; provisional credit excludes goods-not-received/not-as-described.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
P2P dispute existence must not be presented as a guaranteed reversal.
sources.local_note: P2P disputes in-app; 60 days; provisional credit rules; phone 9AM-7PM.

sources.title: Cash App for families
sources.claim: Managed accounts 6-12 (no app access) and sponsored accounts 13-17; spending limits by amount and place; scheduled allowance weekly or monthly; card lock; sponsor must be 15+ years older and is legal owner; no fees.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
Allowance cadence differs from learn article (weekly, biweekly, monthly per search snippet).
sources.local_note: Managed 6-12, sponsored 13-17; parental limits; allowance weekly/monthly; sponsor 15 yrs older, legal owner.

sources.title: Setting Up Cash App for Kids and Teens
sources.claim: Real-time notifications (automatic for managed; Family hub toggle for sponsored); monthly card spend cap; merchant blocking (teen only); approved contacts (managed up to 5); sponsor-enabled investing with monthly limit (teen only); sponsored accounts private by default.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
sources.local_note: Notifications, monthly cap, merchant block (teens), approved contacts, teen investing cap, private by default.

sources.title: Introducing Approved Contacts
sources.claim: Sponsors can restrict teen P2P to approved contacts; off-list payments paused for sponsor review; sponsors can block/report users and control feature access.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
Press release; feature availability not verified in-app.
sources.local_note: Approved contacts: off-list teen payments paused for sponsor review.

sources.title: Cash App Card
sources.claim: No monthly fees; weekly custom cash back offers; concert presales; customization with stamps/emojis/drawing; black/white styles free, fee to change design; 18+ or 13-17 sponsored; no P.O. Box; card can't go negative without overdraft.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
sources.local_note: Card: offers, presales, custom designs (fee for redesign), no negative balance without overdraft.

sources.title: Buy and Trade Stocks
sources.claim: Buy stocks/ETFs from $1; orders schedulable 24/7 but placed in market hours; shortfall debited from linked debit card; view investments in Money > Stocks; sale proceeds to Cash balance up to 1 business day; SIPC.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
sources.local_note: Stocks/ETFs from $1; 24/7 scheduling, market-hours execution; holdings in Money > Stocks.

sources.title: Buy and Sell Bitcoin
sources.claim: Buy from $1; Auto Invest, Round Ups, paid in bitcoin; send/receive incl. Lightning and QR; withdraw to self-custody anytime; 1:1 reserve; IDV may be required first.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
sources.local_note: Bitcoin buy/sell, Auto Invest, Round Ups, send/receive, Lightning, withdraw to self-custody.

sources.title: Cash App Direct Deposit
sources.claim: Up to $25,000 per direct deposit and $50,000 per 24 hours; available as soon as received, up to two days earlier than many banks; first deposit may take longer.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
Related snippet says DD can take 1-5 business days from scheduled date — conflicts with early-pay framing.
sources.local_note: DD up to $25k each/$50k per 24h; available on receipt, up to 2 days early.

sources.title: Someone sent me a payment that's pending
sources.claim: Incoming payments may show Pending and require Accept in Activity; may land on a different account tied to another phone/email.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
sources.local_note: Pending incoming payments require Accept; check other account identifiers.

sources.title: How to Send and Receive Money on Cash App
sources.claim: Send via $cashtag, phone or email; search by name/$cashtag/phone/email; request min $1 via app or link; non-users pay links via Apple/Google Pay; privacy settings control requests.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
sources.local_note: Send/request by $cashtag/phone/email; request links; non-user pay via Apple/Google Pay.

sources.title: Cash App Security
sources.claim: 24/7 fraud monitoring; Zero Fraud Liability; card lock declines until unlocked; Security Lock (face/fingerprint/PIN); alerts for sign-ins, large transactions and settings changes; report scam in-app; chat 24/7.
caveats: Public claim, not exercised behavior or API authority.
Claims like '$2B+ scam losses prevented' are marketing, not verifiable.
sources.local_note: Fraud monitoring, card lock, security lock, alerts for sign-ins/large txns/settings, report scam.
